statement: ∀ (a : ℤ) (j : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → Even a → Odd j → 3 ≤ j → let d := ((⟨a,1⟩ : GaussianInt)^j).im - (-1 : ℤ)^((j-1)/2); d ≠ 0 ∧ padicValNat 2 d.natAbs = padicValNat 2 (j.choose 2) + 2 * padicValNat 2 a.natAbs

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 二项展开的最低二进赋值
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Find the unique least two-adic valuation in the binomial expansion

brief.zh: 对非零偶数 $a$ 与奇数 $j\ge3$，设 $s=(-1)^{(j-1)/2}$。证明 $v_2(\Im(a+i)^j-s)=v_2\binom j2+2v_2(a)$，且差非零。展开 $\Im$，首个非常数项是 $\pm\binom j2a^2$。对 $2\le t\le(j-1)/2$，用 $(2t)(2t-1)\binom j{2t}=j(j-1)\binom{j-2}{2t-2}$ 得 $v_2\binom j{2t}\ge v_2\binom j2-v_2(t)$。$2(t-1)v_2(a)>v_2(t)$ 使其余项的赋值严格较高。
brief.en: Compare each higher even power of a against the first nonconstant term using the binomial coefficient identity.
